text: Test the experience under workshop conditions.

The draft product calls for language support in English and French, keyboard-accessible controls and layouts that work on small screens. It also needs reliable reconnection, outage handling, activity records and facilitator continuity planning. Testing must include simultaneous offers and isolation between rooms. A manual fallback may be necessary if digital service cannot safely continue.

items: One learner's successful screen test does not prove that ten teams receive consistent results during simultaneous bidding.

text: Treat accessibility, resilience and usability as properties to demonstrate through relevant tests.
A passed unit test is not a human usability study or official approval.
